# CLI

Use `--display-name <name>` to select a user.
files.tests/test_cli.py:
import pytest

from src.cli import parse_args


def test_display_name_option():
    assert parse_args(['--display-name', 'Ada']).display_name == 'Ada'


def test_user_name_option_is_not_supported():
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
        parse_args(['--user-name', 'Ada'])
